card.fires_on: Small linking words (during, as, about, in, of, that) right after Freud's name or a Freud claim, in text about psychoanalytic theories of development and sexuality.

modes.label: Words after Freud's claims
modes.description: Prepositions or conjunctions following a statement of what Freud believed or wrote.
modes.example: Freud was convinced that neuroticism was caused by frustrations that a patient underwent<< during>> important sexual phases of their early lives.
